text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mei Satake invited me out for an outing. 
And so, I arrived at the designated 
meeting spot, but……

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
To be precise, it's 'in front of the VR 
Umalator.'

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Come now, worry not! You will understand 
once we arrive! In you go into the 
Umalator, chop chop!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Stepping into the VR space, I stared in 
awe at the panoramic scene. The sky was a 
different color from Japan's, stone 
buildings lined the view, and this massive 
river must be……

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Correct! It's a commercially available VR 
tourism program, but... the quality is far 
beyond expectations!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Now then, allow me to show you around this 
town today—no, the country where I was 
raised!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Here's a ranch! When people think of 
France, they think of a great agricultural 
powerhouse! Famous for cheese, their dairy 
farming is booming!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
How's that for spacious! When I was 
little, I used to race goats at an 
acquaintance's ranch!
choice_data_list: Do you love running as well, Ms. Satake?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
You bet! Ever since I was little, I'd get 
so fired up after watching races that I'd 
just start running. Race after race, 
alongside the goats...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Well, thanks to that, as you can see, I'm 
as fit as a fiddle and bursting with 
health! Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
This is a cafe I used to frequent when I 
was a student. Their hot chocolate is 
super sweet and deliciousâI highly 
recommend it!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Refueling on sugar while exchanging 
debates with my classmates…… Man, 
discussions about Umamusume racing 
theories can get seriously heated――

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Take, for instance, the physical toll 
environmental changes take on Umamusume. 
First is temperature. The chill of France 
can be――mm, this will take too long.
choice_data_list:
You've been passionate about this for a 
long time, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! For anyone who loves this country 
and loves racing, such passion is only 
natural!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I toured various spots across 
France with Mei Satake. I got to hear 
countless stories from her past along the 
way――

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Now then, the perfect finale has to be 
right here! Longchamp Racecourse!
choice_data_list:
It's a breathtaking sight no matter how 
many times I see it……!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Such imposing grandeur, born of history 
and passion. Naturally, it holds a deeply 
special place in my heart as well!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
—Joy, and bitter frustration. Living in 
this country, I have tasted them time and 
again.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...On the grand stage of their beloved 
France, bearing pride in their hearts as 
they claim the title of the world's 
strongest—those Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I love that side of you. That radiant 
smile after a brilliant performance! It 
fills me with pride, too!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Yet at the same time... as a Japanese 
citizen, my heart screamed out in pure 
regret.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Behind the glory, challengers who came 
from far away in Japan wept with bated 
breath.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Just how much resolve must it have taken? 
Just how much pressure must she have felt?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I endured, endured, and pushed through! I 
fought so hard to finally stand here and 
challenge this!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Unable to fulfill her vow, left only with 
bitter regret! Leaving this land in tears! 
That image is burned into my mind, and it 
won't let go...!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...That's why I dreamed it!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
In this countryâin my beloved France! 
The dream of a Japanese Umamusume becoming 
the best in the world!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
The day two nations stand side by side, 
and great smiles bloom like giant 
blossoms!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
If such an incredible day were to come, 
how—just how overjoyed I would be!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Tch!
choice_data_list:
I came this far sharing that exact same 
conviction!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Gh, ah! Thank you, I'm sorry, thank you 
so much...!!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Ngggh!! I can't just sit around doing 
nothing!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>, would you mind heading back to 
the academy to give me some advice on my 
plan!?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
With you—if it's with you, from here on 
out, I feel like I can keep chasing my 
dreams forever!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not to be outdone by her burning passion, 
I nodded with utter conviction. Together, 
we took that first step toward the future 
to come.
